motion.lenis: Mandatory integration of @studio-freight/lenis for smooth scrolling.

framer_motion.hero_3d_cards: Use useScroll and useTransform for parallax. Use onMouseMove with useSpring for 3D tilt effects on glass panels.

components.navigation: Fixed top, w-full, z-50. Starts transparent, becomes backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#040A18]/80 border-b border-white/[0.05] on scroll.
components.charts: Recharts integration. Use CustomTooltip. Colors: Teal (#14B8A6), Blue (#3B82F6), Indigo (#6366F1). Animate on mount. No pure white backgrounds for charts, use transparent or navy_card.

layouts.hero: Min-h-screen, center aligned content logically but visually offset with 3D floating glass panels on the right/background. Generous pt-32 pb-20.
layouts.spacing: Use py-24 md:py-32 for section spacing to ensure premium 'breathing room'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark Navy and Teal theme. Do NOT use generic slate or gray backgrounds.
Use Fraunces for headings, Inter for body text. Install the fonts properly in index.css.
DO NOT mention 'AI models', 'LLMs', or 'Neural Networks'. Focus entirely on 'Physician-in-the-loop', 'Clinical Intelligence', 'Augmented Care'.
Build the interactive Aurora background using CSS gradients and framer-motion.
Create a Hero section featuring floating 3D glass panels reacting to mouse movements.
Implement an interactive Diabetes statistics section using Recharts with animated count-ups and distinct Recharts charts (bar/donut/line).
DO NOT use a transparent background for dropdowns or the sticky header. Always use a backdrop blur with semi-solid color.
Include standard data-testid attributes for all interactive elements.
Ensure all sections seamlessly blend. Avoid hard lines; use gradient masks or spacious padding.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Focus on high-end, Awwwards-winning execution. Prioritize visual tension, generous padding, and micro-interactions. Avoid centered, boring Bootstrap-like grids. Layer elements. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. Never use AI emojis.
